name: Stara Planina Hold Plc
summary: Stara Planina Hold Plc manufactures and sells hydraulic systems in Bulgaria and internationally. The company offers hydraulic piston, plunger, telescopic, and rack cylinders; and hydraulic motors, hydrostatic power steering systems, hydraulic valves, breaks, and accessories. It also offers starter, traction, and stationary batteries. In addition, the company provides natural flavour waters, sauces and compositions, concretes, perfumery cosmetics, essences, and aromas for the food industry; and rose and lavender oils. Further, it offers women and men top knitwear; and sport, women, men, and kid's socks. The company was formerly known as Central Privatization Fund and changed its name to Stara Planina Hold Plc in April 1999. Stara Planina Hold PLC was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Sofia, Bulgaria.
